text: 你恢复意识时，发现自己裹在厚重的兽皮中，四周黑影幢幢，自己似乎被人控制住了。你大声呼救，一双有力的手却稳住了你。一个低沉的声音说：“我们发现你在林中游荡。休息吧。很快就能到堡垒了。那里很安全。”
救你的人是Tsuut’ina猎人。你躺在独木舟底部，他们划船顺流而下。你虚弱得无力提问，只能安静休息。
正如他们所说，你们最终抵达麦克唐纳堡。皇家骑警给你暖和的衣服和热腾腾的饭菜，随后询问你的同伴遭遇了什么。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 161
text: When your senses clear, you find yourself wrapped in heavy pelts, confined, surrounded by dark presences. You cry out, but strong hands steady you. A deep voice speaks: “We found you wandering in the woods. Rest. Soon we shall reach the fort. You’ll be safe there.”
Your rescuers are Tsuut’ina hunters. You lie in the bottom of a canoe while they paddle downstream. You rest quietly, too weak to ask questions.
As they promise, you eventually reach Fort McDonald. The Mounties give you warm clothes and a hot meal before asking what happened to your companions.
